description: Hermes Agent usage: turns, model requests, tokens, subscription cost status, counterfactual Standard API-equivalent cost, tool behavior, latency, and trace drill-down.

panels.description: Completed Hermes turns found in Tempo over the selected dashboard range.
panels.title: Turns

panels.description: Cache-read tokens divided by input plus cache-read tokens.
panels.title: Cache-read Ratio

panels.description: Total tokens observed within exactly the selected dashboard range, grouped by token type. Prometheus increase() accounts for counter resets; values are rounded because boundary extrapolation can otherwise produce fractional tokens.
panels.title: Tokens — Selected Range

panels.description: Token processing rate by token type. Rates remain comparable when the dashboard time range or display resolution changes; selected-range totals are shown separately.
panels.title: Token Throughput by Type

panels.description: Tool latency excludes clarify because it measures human waiting time.
panels.title: Tool p95 Latency (Non-interactive)

panels.description: Clarify duration represents time waiting for a user response.
panels.title: Interactive Wait Time

panels.description: Estimated monetary cost. The current provider marks requests as included, so zero is expected.
panels.title: Cost Status

panels.description: Hermes turn spans over time from Tempo. Open Tempo Explore for individual trace inspection.
panels.title: Turn Throughput

panels.description: Counterfactual OpenAI Standard API-equivalent cost incurred within the selected dashboard time range. This is a rolling-window total: it can decrease when older usage leaves the selected range. Not an invoice; hosted-tool fees are excluded.
panels.title: Hypothetical API Cost — Selected Range

panels.description: Smoothed counterfactual Standard API-equivalent spend rate in USD per hour, grouped by priced model and context band. This is a rate, not a total; use the selected-range stat for the period total. Not an invoice.
panels.title: Hypothetical API Spend Rate (USD/hour)

panels.description: Time remaining until each Codex subscription limit resets. Grafana automatically chooses seconds, minutes, hours, or days and shows one decimal of precision. Calculated from the numeric reset gauge, so reset timestamps remain values rather than high-cardinality labels. Model-specific rolling reset estimates may move forward when Codex refreshes them.
panels.title: Next Codex Resets

panels.description: Latest remaining fraction for every Codex subscription limit returned by the account usage API. The plugin polls at HERMES_OTEL_CODEX_USAGE_INTERVAL_SECONDS (default 300 seconds).
panels.title: Codex Limits Remaining

panels.description: Remaining Codex subscription allowance over time, one series per account limit. The companion hermes_codex_limit_reset_seconds metric records reset times without using high-cardinality timestamp labels.
panels.title: Codex Limit History

title: Hermes Usage
